## Description {#details}

<p>Tagged DWARF-like metadata node.</p>


<p>A metadata node with a DWARF tag (i.e., a constant named <span class="doxyComputerOutput">DW_TAG_*</span>, defined in <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/binaryformat/dwarf-h">llvm/BinaryFormat/Dwarf.h</a>). Called <em><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/dinode">DINode</a></em> because it's potentially used for non-DWARF output.</p>


<p>Uses the SubclassData16 <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/metadata">Metadata</a> slot.</p>


<p>Definition at line 135 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/debuginfometadata-h">DebugInfoMetadata.h</a>.</p>
